Problem Statement:
Write a program to check whether the given string is a pan card format or not. if its pan card format print Yes otherwise No 
Input Description:
Iinput contains the string 
Output Description:
Print Yes or No 
Sample Input:
CSBDS1111C 
Sample Output:
Yes 
Explanation:
Pan card format will be first five characters in alphabet and the next four characters in numeric then another one character will be in alphabet
